units: Gitt. IV, 1 ב׳ הוא is void (revoked); v. בְּטֵל Ithpe.; a. fr.—Pl. בְּטֵלִים, בְּטֵלִין, בְּטֵי׳.—דברים ב׳ vanities, absurdities.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 21a">Snh. 21ᵃ</cite> one horse <he>והוא ב׳</he> when not needed (for war).
Koh. R. to VI, 8.—Pl. as supra.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 1:4:2">Y. Meg. I, 70ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>עשרה בטילין … לביה״כ</he> (where there are) ten men at leisure for attending Synagogue, v. <cite ref="B00520"><he>בַּטְלָן</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Berakhot 16a:11">Ber. 16ᵃ</cite> <he>והוא שב׳ ממלאכתן</he> provided they stop working.
<cite ref="Berakhot 17b:7">Ib. 17ᵇ</cite> <he>ת״ח ב׳</he> scholars have to abstain from work; a. fr.—Fem. <cite ref="B00518"><he>בְּטֵלָה</he></cite>, <cite ref="B00511"><he>בְּטֵילָה</he></cite>.
